parts.text: Describe the case study as a research method.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Design an alternative study to the Loftus and Pickrell study as a case study and describe how
it could be conducted.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Evaluate this alternative way of studying false memories in practical and ethical terms.

text: Loftus and Pickrell conducted a laboratory experiment to investigate the formation of false
memories. An alternative way to investigate this would be to conduct an investigation into false
memories using the case study method.

to everyday life. 
Section B (20 marks)
Answer one question from this section.

text: Haney, Banks and Zimbardo (prison simulation) investigated the effect of social roles on behaviour.

parts.text:

Milgram (obedience)
Piliavin et al (subway Samaritans)
Tajfel (intergroup categorisation)

parts.text: What problems may psychologists have when investigating social behaviour?
